ticks.note: It leaves the upper limit switch, and then it sticks: `isDown` never comes.

Four: `if 4 true go to Stuck` fires. `Stuck` is final, so `Working` terminates and `join to Fault` fires in the same tick. `Fault` lights the fault lamp, keeps the lamps flashing and keeps commanding the barrier down.
The train has passed, but `Fault` does not care: only the maintainer can end it.
The maintainer has freed the barrier (it is up again) and turns the key: `restart`. `Fault`'s exit action clears the fault lamp, the lamps and the motor command, and `Working` starts again in `Open`.
